hk2.title: Uni Kuru Toga Dive Aurora Purple 0.5mm Mechanical Pencil M5-5000 No.2
hk2.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
hk2.details: Uni Kuru Toga Dive mechanical pencil in Aurora Purple, 0.5 mm lead, model M5-5000. The Kuru Toga mechanism rotates the lead as you write so that it keeps a sharp point. Pre-owned with a fair number of light scratches and scuffs on the body and cap from use, as shown in the photos. It does not come with a box. Please check the photos for the exact condition.
hk2.why: A Kuru Toga Dive mechanical pencil with the lead-rotating mechanism, in Aurora Purple, offered at a lower price because of its scratches.
hk2.perfect: Stationery fans and people who write a lot.
hk2.exp: A pre-owned Uni Kuru Toga Dive pencil with light scratches and no box.
hk2.cd: Pre-owned. Light scratches and scuffs on the body and cap, more than a few, as shown in the photos. No box. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
